name: Shyama Computronics and Services Limited
summary: Established in 1996 and headquartered in Kolkata, India, Shyama Computronics and Services Limited operates as a comprehensive information technology service provider, serving clients across India and globally. The company, previously known as Shyama Infosys Limited until its name change in July 2024, specializes in the full lifecycle of telecommunications hardware and software systems, from design and development to customization, sales, franchising, and licensing. Its extensive portfolio includes internet-centric solutions like multimedia applications, e-commerce platforms, digital publishing (e-magazines, news, articles, and information), electronic media, and advanced data transfer and networking capabilities. Additionally, Shyama Computronics offers a wide array of services, such as web hosting, cutting-edge internet and server technologies, OPT IN-Mall solutions, database management, integrated digital networks, VOIP networks, private networks, and various other internet-based offerings.
